description: Wait for a task started by run_task or retrieve_data and return its status, latest progress and, once finished, its result. Returns as soon as the task finishes, or after wait_seconds with status "running" (call again). Tasks are kept for an hour after they finish and are lost when this server restarts.

task_id.description: The task_id returned by run_task or retrieve_data.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the task to finish before answering. 0 answers immediately.

name: get_task
title: Check a task
